question: In 2023, the International Astronomical Union named a minor planet after Indian meteor astronomer __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aswin Sekhar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Astronomical Union is a nongovernmental organization with the objective of advancing astronomy in all aspects, including promoting astronomical research, outreach, education, and development through global cooperation.

 
 
• It was founded in 1919 and is based in Paris, France__.
 
 

International Astronomical Union:

__
 
• It was formed on 28 July 1919.
 
• Its president is Evin van Dishoek.
 
• Maria Teresa Lago is the Secretary General.
 
• Headquarters: Paris, France

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Anke Kaysser-Pyzalla is the current Administrator of the German Aerospace Center.
 
• Bill Nelson is the current Administrator of NASA.
 
• Josef Aschbacher is the current Administrator of the European Space Agency.
